section_summary.extract_value: This section presents the conclusions of the study, emphasizing the need for more research on how social exposure influences young women's body image. The results suggest that interacting with non-body focused individuals can lead to adaptive body image outcomes, even if interactions with body-focused individuals are frequent. This benefit may be immediate and carry over to the next day, highlighting the importance of promoting non-body focused social interactions for protecting against maladaptive eating and body image patterns.
